who: Jena (one n). This is her own body map: every bone and face shape her avatar has, what each one does, and which tracked point drives it when she copies a move from a video.
left_right: Left and right always mean HER OWN left and right. She faces the camera, so her left hand is on the RIGHT of your screen. When she learns from a video she uses the performer's own left/right (a mirrored video is un-mirrored first), and plays it left->left on herself, never mirrored.

hips.does: the root of her whole body: moves her up/down and sways her weight from foot to foot; everything else hangs off it

spine.does: bends and twists her lower back

chest.does: leans and turns her upper body

upperChest.does: the top of her torso, where her shoulders and neck attach; small extra twist and lean

neck.does: tilts and turns her head a little (shared with the head)

head.does: nods (yes), shakes (no), tilts toward a shoulder

leftEye.does: looks around; her left eye (on the right of the screen when she faces you). Blinks with blinkLeft

leftShoulder.does: shrugs her left shoulder up / rolls it forward

leftUpperArm.does: raises her left arm out to the side, forward, up over her head, or down by her side

leftLowerArm.does: bends her left elbow and twists her left forearm (palm up / palm down)

leftHand.does: tilts and turns her left hand at the wrist: waving, pointing, palm facing you

leftThumbMetacarpal.part: left thumb, thumb base (at the palm)
leftThumbMetacarpal.does: curls her left thumb at the thumb base (at the palm) and swings the thumb across the palm

leftThumbProximal.does: curls her left thumb at the thumb middle joint

leftThumbDistal.does: curls her left thumb at the thumb tip joint

leftIndexProximal.does: curls her left index (pointer) finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

leftIndexIntermediate.does: curls her left index (pointer) finger at the middle joint

leftIndexDistal.does: curls her left index (pointer) finger at the tip joint

leftMiddleProximal.does: curls her left middle finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

leftMiddleIntermediate.does: curls her left middle finger at the middle joint

leftMiddleDistal.does: curls her left middle finger at the tip joint

leftRingProximal.does: curls her left ring finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

leftRingIntermediate.does: curls her left ring finger at the middle joint

leftRingDistal.does: curls her left ring finger at the tip joint

leftLittleProximal.does: curls her left little finger (pinky) at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

leftLittleIntermediate.does: curls her left little finger (pinky) at the middle joint

leftLittleDistal.does: curls her left little finger (pinky) at the tip joint

leftUpperLeg.does: swings her left leg forward/back/out to the side and lifts her left knee

leftFoot.does: points / flexes her left foot and lifts her left heel

leftToes.does: bends her left toes when she rises onto the ball of her foot

rightEye.does: looks around; her right eye (on the left of the screen when she faces you). Blinks with blinkRight

rightShoulder.does: shrugs her right shoulder up / rolls it forward

rightUpperArm.does: raises her right arm out to the side, forward, up over her head, or down by her side

rightLowerArm.does: bends her right elbow and twists her right forearm (palm up / palm down)

rightHand.does: tilts and turns her right hand at the wrist: waving, pointing, palm facing you

rightThumbMetacarpal.part: right thumb, thumb base (at the palm)
rightThumbMetacarpal.does: curls her right thumb at the thumb base (at the palm) and swings the thumb across the palm

rightThumbProximal.does: curls her right thumb at the thumb middle joint

rightThumbDistal.does: curls her right thumb at the thumb tip joint

rightIndexProximal.does: curls her right index (pointer) finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

rightIndexIntermediate.does: curls her right index (pointer) finger at the middle joint

rightIndexDistal.does: curls her right index (pointer) finger at the tip joint

rightMiddleProximal.does: curls her right middle finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

rightMiddleIntermediate.does: curls her right middle finger at the middle joint

rightMiddleDistal.does: curls her right middle finger at the tip joint

rightRingProximal.does: curls her right ring finger at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

rightRingIntermediate.does: curls her right ring finger at the middle joint

rightRingDistal.does: curls her right ring finger at the tip joint

rightLittleProximal.does: curls her right little finger (pinky) at the knuckle (and spreads it sideways)

rightLittleIntermediate.does: curls her right little finger (pinky) at the middle joint

rightLittleDistal.does: curls her right little finger (pinky) at the tip joint

rightUpperLeg.does: swings her right leg forward/back/out to the side and lifts her right knee

rightFoot.does: points / flexes her right foot and lifts her right heel

rightToes.does: bends her right toes when she rises onto the ball of her foot

ih.does: mouth "ih", upper lip lifted a little

ou.does: lips pushed forward in a small round "oo" (pucker)

sad.does: mouth corners down, inner brows up

surprised.does: brows up, eyes wide, mouth a little open

lookLeft.does: eyes look to HER left (your right)

lookRight.does: eyes look to HER right (your left)

not_on_this_body: jaw bone (her mouth opens with the aa/oh shapes instead)
separate eyebrow bones (brows move inside the angry/sad/surprised shapes)

tracking.body: MediaPipe Pose: 33 points (0 nose, 1-6 eyes, 7-8 ears, 9-10 mouth, 11-12 shoulders, 13-14 elbows, 15-16 wrists, 17-22 hand edges, 23-24 hips, 25-26 knees, 27-28 ankles, 29-30 heels, 31-32 toes); odd = performer's left, even = right
tracking.hands: MediaPipe Hands: 21 points per hand (0 wrist, 1-4 thumb, 5-8 index, 9-12 middle, 13-16 ring, 17-20 pinky) -> 15 finger joint bends + spread per hand
tracking.face: MediaPipe Face: 478 points + 52 blendshapes (jaw, mouth, lips, cheeks, brows, eyes, gaze) -> her VRM face shapes
tracking.low_light: dark or low-confidence video is retried with CLAHE+gamma, then inverted colours; the best pass is kept and logged
